responsibility: This implementation module is the public heap-allocation wrapper that forwards all storage operations directly to SysStorage. It does not implement allocation policy itself; instead it provides the standard Storage module entry points ALLOCATE, DEALLOCATE, REALLOCATE, and Available that higher-level gm2 code imports, separating the public storage interface from the system-level allocator backend.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Storage pair: rather than defining heap policy itself, it simply implements the Storage.def entry points by delegating each one to SysStorage.
